images.note: HBC 266 (J16284527-2428190, 82 pc, M3.75, 0.43" binary): compact, marginally resolved round emission; the 0.43" binary components cannot be separated in the SMA data and the system was fitted as a single source; F_294GHz = 113.5 +/- 9.0 mJy (Table 4); R_95% disk = 0.39" (quoted from Shoshi et al. 2025 in Table 1). Image covers the 8"-wide square field centred on the source peak, contours from 3 sigma in 3-sigma steps, hatched ellipse = synthesized beam. The 286-298 GHz data come from the SMA 270 GHz tracks 270GHz-2a (2022-05-23, EXT config) and 270GHz-1 (2023-08-29, COM config), concatenated to a 0.8"-1.2" FWHM beam; the paper does not state per-target track assignments.

notes: First-published SPHERE/IRDIS H-band polarimetric image (SPHERE GTO, program 1100.C-0481, PI Beuzit). Reveals a stellar companion at 0.24 arcsec (28 au) and a faint, compact polarimetric emission centered on the primary star, plus an extended feature beyond the companion's projected separation (Garufi et al. 2026).
